description: This file defines a graphPopulator struct and functions to add event handlers for Kubernetes resource informers, managing updates and deletions of Pods, PersistentVolumes, VolumeAttachments, ResourceSlices, and PodCertificateRequests within a node authorization context.

classes.name: graphPopulator
classes.description: A struct that holds a reference to a Graph and provides methods to handle Kubernetes resource events for populating the graph.

methods.name: AddGraphEventHandlers
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for various Kubernetes resource informers to update the graph accordingly.

methods.name: addPod
methods.description: Handles the addition of a Pod to the graph.

methods.name: updatePod
methods.description: Handles updates to a Pod, adding it to the graph if it is assigned to a node and has relevant changes.

methods.name: deletePod
methods.description: Handles deletion of a Pod from the graph.

methods.name: addPV
methods.description: Handles the addition of a PersistentVolume to the graph.

methods.name: updatePV
methods.description: Handles updates to a PersistentVolume, adding it to the graph.

methods.name: deletePV
methods.description: Handles deletion of a PersistentVolume from the graph.

methods.name: addVolumeAttachment
methods.description: Handles the addition of a VolumeAttachment to the graph.

methods.name: updateVolumeAttachment
methods.description: Handles updates to a VolumeAttachment, adding it if the node name has changed.

methods.name: deleteVolumeAttachment
methods.description: Handles deletion of a VolumeAttachment from the graph.

methods.name: addResourceSlice
methods.description: Handles the addition of a ResourceSlice to the graph.

methods.name: deleteResourceSlice
methods.description: Handles deletion of a ResourceSlice from the graph.

methods.name: addPCR
methods.description: Handles the addition of a PodCertificateRequest to the graph.

methods.name: deletePCR
methods.description: Handles deletion of a PodCertificateRequest from the graph.
